title: RawFinding
description: Raw technical finding emitted by the scanner (GUARDHUB_STANDARDS §7.2, §7.4). Not plain language: the API localises it using check_id + finding_key + params. Single source for Python, Go and TS types (generated by packages/shared/scripts/gen_types.py).

finding_key.description: Finding variant key from check-ids.json; i18n key is checks.<check_id>.<finding_key>.

params.description: Template parameters for the localised texts. Values are short strings and NEVER raw secrets.

fingerprint.description: sha256 hex of check_id|finding_key|evidence.location. Stable across scans (used for diffs).

Evidence.description: Masked proof that supports the finding (§6: never contains a raw secret).

location.description: URL or host:port where the evidence was captured; for repo evidence, the file's GitHub URL (stable across commits).

redacted_payload.description: Short masked excerpt (max 2 KiB). Secrets masked to their last 4 characters.
